resolved.title: 数组 array
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

An [b]array [/b]is used to store a collection of data, but it may be useful to think of an array as a collection of variables that are all of the [b]same type[/b].
Instead of declaring multiple variables and storing individual values, you can declare a single array to store all the values.
When declaring an array, specify its element types, as well as the number of elements it will hold.  
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="cpp" ][b]int [/b]a[5];[/code]
In the example above, variable [b]a[/b] was declared as an array of five integer values [specified in square brackets].
You can initialize the array by specifying the values it holds: [code format="cpp" ]int b[5] = {11, 45, 62, 70, 88};[/code]
The values are provided in a [b]comma [/b]separated list, enclosed in [b]{curly braces}[/b].
[note]The number of values between braces { } must not exceed the number of the elements declared within the square brackets [ ].[/note]

resolved.title: 初始化数组
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Initializing Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

If you omit the size of the array, an array just big enough to hold the initialization is created. 
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="cpp" ]int b[] = {11, 45, 62, 70, 88};[/code]
This creates an identical array to the one created in the previous example.

Each element, or member, of the array has an [b]index[/b], which pinpoints the element's specific position.
The array's first member has the index of 0, the second has the index of 1. 
So, for the array [b]b[/b] that we declared above:  [img id="2459" width="100%"]
To access array elements, index the array name by placing the element's index in square brackets following the array name.
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="cpp" codeId="218"]int b[] = {11, 45, 62, 70, 88};

cout << b[b][0][/b] << endl;

cout<< b[b][3][/b] << endl;
[/code]
[note]Run the code and see how it works![/note]

resolved.title: 访问数组元素
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Accessing Array Elements[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Index numbers may also be used to assign a new value to an element.[code format="cpp" ]int b[] = {11, 45, 62, 70, 88};
b[2] = 42;[/code]
This assigns a value of 42 to the array's third element.
[note]Always remember that the list of elements always begins with the index of 0.[/note]
[s0l0!-coach id="431" name="First, fifth and last" xp="10" description="Write a program to print out certain letters of an array sequentially." imageUrl="/content/assets/3e0a49356e2493f44931.png" button="Start" color="5e98cf"]Practice what you've learned.[/s0l0!-coach]

resolved.title: 数组字母打印
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定一个大小为12的数组`word`。

写一个程序，按顺序只打印数组的第一、第五和最后一个字母。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given an array of size 12.
Write a program to print only the first, fifth and last letters of the array sequentially.

[note]Remember that array indexing starts from 0.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 记住，数组的索引从0开始。
- 注意：字母之间不换行，无空格
